hypothesis: A piecewise prompt-length model may explain the observed cost regimes better than sampling settings. The short-prompt indicators may proxy startup effects in this fixed workload; they do not establish prompt length as their cause.

pcvs.expression: len(request.prompt_token_ids) if request.prompt_token_ids is not None else 0
pcvs.name: prompt_tokens

pcvs.expression: int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and len(request.prompt_token_ids) == 9)
pcvs.name: nine_token_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Separates the observed nine-token state, whose cost substantially exceeds the general baseline.

pcvs.expression: int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and len(request.prompt_token_ids) == 10)
pcvs.name: ten_token_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Separates the highest-cost observed prompt-length state.

pcvs.expression: int(request.prompt_token_ids is not None and 12 <= len(request.prompt_token_ids) < 23)
pcvs.name: medium_prompt
pcvs.rationale: Tests the elevated instruction-cost regime observed for medium prompts.
